definitions.explanation: The process of constructing buildings or infrastructure.

examples.japanese: {建設|けんせつ}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧
{建設|けんせつ}⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: To work at a construction site.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{建設|けんせつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a plan to construct a new hospital in this area.

notes:
{建設|けんせつ} refers to large-scale construction of buildings, infrastructure, and public works. It emphasizes the overall project of building something substantial.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- No standard intransitive pair
- Pattern: [noun]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{建設|けんせつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{建設|けんせつ}{中|ちゅう}→建設中：22326_kensetsuchuu⟧: under construction
- {建設|けんせつ}⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧: construction company
- {建設|けんせつ}⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧: construction site
- {建設|けんせつ}⟦{業|ぎょう}→業：noentry⟧: construction industry
- {建設|けんせつ}⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧: construction costs

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {建設|けんせつ}: large-scale construction (roads, dams, buildings)
- ⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧: architecture, building design and construction (focuses on individual buildings)
- ⟦{建造|けんぞう}→建造：22998_kenzou⟧: construction of large structures (ships, bridges)
- ⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧: construction work (the physical labor/process)

USAGE:
Can be used figuratively: ⟦{国家|こっか}→国家：02760_kokka⟧{建設|けんせつ} (nation-building), ⟦{建設的|けんせつてき}→建設的：06092_kensetsuteki⟧な⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧ (constructive opinion).
